_doc: A2: every ```bash/```sh/```python block of README.md, README.en.md, docs/JURY.md, docs/ADAPTER.md is either RUN by tests/test_docs_examples.py (after the substitutions below; exit code 0 and the expected substring) or SKIPPED here with a reason.
